completion.description: Choose from collected, reliably identified single-episode releases. The highest-scoring version matching current subscription rules is selected by default. State is checked again before submission. Specials and batches require manual handling.

reasons.unaired: Not yet aired; excluded from actionable missing episodes.
reasons.failed: An earlier download failed; choose a candidate to retry.

reasons.aired_no_resource: Already aired; no reliable single-episode release is collected.
